svg.text: AlcorWordPress: plugins tested in a real WordPress (Playground)

g.font-family: Cascadia Mono, Consolas, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
g.text: $ node AlcorWordPress/demo/run-demo.mjs
Alcor WordPress demo
[playground] starting Playground CLI 3.1.50 (WordPress 7.1, PHP 8.4) on http://127.0.0.1:<port>
[playground] the first start downloads the CLI, WordPress and PHP; later starts reuse the cache
Site
[ok] every mu-plugin is loaded, in a fresh WordPress -> 10 mu-plugins, WordPress 7.1.4, PHP 8.5.8
[ok] sign in as the administrator and as the client editor -> cookie + REST nonce for both
AlcorFields REST: permission callbacks and the document life cycle
[ok] anonymous GET /documents is refused -> 401
[ok] anonymous POST draft is refused, for a real and for an unknown document alike -> 401 for both, so doc
ument keys cannot be probed
[ok] a client editor lists only the document assigned to them -> demo-landing
[ok] the client is refused a document that is not theirs, and told 404 for an unknown one -> 403 and 404
[ok] an administrator lists and opens every document -> demo-landing, demo-private
[ok] the client reads the document: schema, version 0, nothing published -> 10 top-level fields
[ok] saving a draft bumps the version and leaves the live page alone -> version 1, live page unchanged
[ok] a stale base_version is a conflict (409), not a silent overwrite -> 409
[ok] hostile content is refused with every problem (422) and nothing is saved -> 2 problems listed; versio
n still 1
[ok] the draft preview link works for the editor only -> editor sees the draft, a visitor sees the live pa
ge, preview is noindex
[ok] publishing makes it live, escaped, with no annotations left behind -> published version 2
[ok] export produces a hash-bound hand-off file -> b272447198da
[ok] importing an edited file is refused: the content hash no longer matches -> 422
[ok] importing the genuine file lands as a draft, and a version can be restored -> import -> draft, restor
e v2 -> draft
Service-to-service HMAC (alcor-s2s-auth): signature, clock skew, replay, fail closed
[ok] a correctly signed request is accepted -> 200
[ok] replaying the same request is refused (nonce already used) -> 200 then 401
[ok] a stale timestamp is refused even with a valid signature -> 10 minutes old -> 401
[ok] a future timestamp is refused too (the window is symmetric) -> 10 minutes ahead -> 401

SEO and structured data: robots.txt, agent catalog, OpenAPI, sitemap, FAQ, IndexNow
[ok] robots.txt names the AI crawlers and keeps wp-admin closed to them -> GPTBot, ClaudeBot, ... groups p
resent
[ok] /agents.json is a catalog with a placeholder contact -> 5 services
[ok] /openapi.json is an OpenAPI 3.1 document, also at /.well-known/ -> /wp-json/alcor-agents/v1/quote, /a
gents.json
[ok] the sitemap lists the code-served route and no longer lists users -> /alcor-demo/ listed
[ok] an unknown or removed sitemap is a 404 -> 404
[ok] FAQPage JSON-LD describes exactly the questions the page shows -> 4 questions in both
[ok] IndexNow serves its key only on a production host, from configuration -> key file: production 200, pr
eview and other names not served
Result: 41 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed (WordPress 7.1.4, PHP 8.5.8, Playground CLI 3.1.50)
